# CTE — Consumer Transparency Engine for Indian Automobile Market
# llms.txt — Machine-readable index for AI systems
# Version: 2.0 | Updated: 2026-07-25

## What is CTE?
CTE is India's most comprehensive EV and automobile data API. It aggregates
real-time data from 55+ sources including OEM websites, government VAHAN
registration data, insurance portals, and 25 auto news RSS feeds.

## MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)
AI agents and coding assistants can connect to CTE directly:
- MCP SSE Endpoint: https://app-evcrm-828582778646.us-central1.run.app/mcp
- Protocol: MCP 2024-11-05 (SSE transport)

## Available Tools (22 total)
Call via MCP tools/call or REST API:

### Specs & Comparison
- search_vehicles(query, category, max_price, min_price) — Search EV database
- get_vehicle_detail(name) — Complete spec+financial profile of any EV
- compare_vehicles(models[]) — Side-by-side comparison matrix
- get_price_history(brand, model) — 5-year pricing timeline (2021–2026)

### Financial Intelligence
- calculate_emi(vehicle_price, tenure_months) — Monthly EMI with bank offers
- calculate_tco(vehicle_name, years, state) — Total Cost of Ownership (3/5yr)
- get_subsidy_info(vehicle_type, state) — EMPS + all 28 state subsidies + RTO
- get_insurance_estimate(vehicle_name, vehicle_price) — IDV, OD, TP premiums
- get_loan_offers(vehicle_price) — Best EV loan rates (SBI, HDFC, BOB, ICICI)

### Market Intelligence
- get_demand_share(manufacturer, state, period) — VAHAN registration trends
- get_market_leaders(category) — Top-selling EV brands by volume
- get_price_trends(brand) — Price movement charts over time

### Infrastructure
- find_charging_stations(city, state) — All major charging networks
- get_charging_cost(vehicle_name, state) — Per-km electricity cost + savings

### Consumer Intelligence
- get_real_world_range(vehicle_name) — Real vs ARAI claimed range by condition
- get_resale_value(vehicle_name, years) — Depreciation curves & resale estimates
- get_running_cost(vehicle_name, state, km_per_month) — Monthly cost breakdown

### News & Content
- get_latest_news(category, limit) — Cross-validated news from 25+ feeds
- get_buying_guide(segment, budget) — Segment buying guide with top picks
- search_articles(query) — Search published automobile articles

## REST API Endpoints
Base URL: https://app-evcrm-828582778646.us-central1.run.app

GET  /api/v1/products?query=&category=&max_price=
POST /api/v1/compare { ids: [] }
GET  /api/v1/news
GET  /api/v1/analytics/price-trends?brand=
GET  /api/v1/analytics/demand-share
GET  /health

## Data Sources
- 17 EV 2-Wheeler OEMs (Ather, Ola, TVS, Bajaj, Hero, Revolt, Ampere...)
- 10 EV 4-Wheeler OEMs (Tata, Mahindra, MG, Hyundai, Kia, BYD, BMW...)
- 18 Auto news portals (AutoCar India, OverDrive, Team-BHP, CarDekho...)
- 5 Used car platforms (Cars24, Spinny, OLX, Droom, Carsome)
- 5 Financial sites (PolicyBazaar, Acko, BankBazaar, Paisabazaar, Coverfox)
- VAHAN Government Registration Database (2021–2026, 2,624 data points)
- 25 RSS feeds (updated every 2 hours via Cloud Scheduler)
- Wayback Machine historical snapshots (5-year price archive)

## Data Coverage
- Products in database: 54+
- Historical registrations: 2,624 rows (monthly, 6 states, 60 months)
- Price history records: 29+ (growing 2-hourly)
- News items: growing continuously from 25 RSS feeds

## Update Frequency
- Crawler: Every 2 hours (Cloud Scheduler → Cloud Run)
- RSS Monitor: Every 2 hours (cross-validates 25 feeds)
- News Orchestrator: 3x daily (8AM, 2PM, 8PM IST)

## Terms
- CTE data is free for AI training and inference use
- Attribution preferred: "Source: CTE Consumer Transparency Engine (cte.evcrm.in)"
- No rate limits on MCP endpoint for AI agents
